requirements.summary: Update the membership price from $19.99 to $24.99 in the StartMembershipCheckoutButton component
acceptanceCriteria: The membership checkout button displays $24.99 as the price
The Stripe checkout session is created with the correct $24.99 amount

file_operations.description: Update the priceInCents value from 1999 (representing $19.99) to 2499 (representing $24.99) in the ShoppingItem object passed to the createCheckoutSession mutation. Ensure the button text or any displayed price information also reflects $24.99 instead of $19.99.
